in_sanskrit.name: मुरलि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the mountain as his abode or the one who has the mountain as his friend.

in_marathi.name: Murali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mūla' meaning root and 'rī' meaning mountain protector. In Hindu mythology, Lord Murugan, a form of Shiva, is also known as Murali. He is the god of mountains, war, and love.

in_bengali.name: Murali

In Hindu mythology, Lord Murugan, a form of Shiva, is also known as Murali. He is the god of mountains, war, and love.
